stories.title: Japan condemns the Houthis attacks on Saudi Arabia

en.title: Japan condemns the Houthis attacks on Saudi Arabia
en.summary: Japan strongly condemned Houthi military attacks on Saudi Arabia, stating they have caused civilian casualties and called for de-escalation. Japan opposed attacks on civilians and actions obstructing maritime navigation.

en.title: Attacks from Iraq on East-West Pipeline Draw Strong Condemnations
en.summary: Attacks on the East-West Pipeline originating from Iraq have drawn strong international condemnation.

en.title: Iraqi Army Commander Sacked After Drone Attacks Targeted Saudi Arabia
en.summary: An Iraqi Army Commander was dismissed following drone attacks that targeted Saudi Arabia.

en.title: GCC Secretary-General Condemns East-West Pipeline Attack in Saudi Arabia
en.summary: The Secretary-General of the Gulf Cooperation Council has issued a condemnation regarding an attack on Saudi Arabia's East-West Pipeline.

en.title: Saudi Arabia Strongly Condemns Drone Attack on East-West Pipeline
en.summary: Saudi Arabia has strongly denounced a drone attack targeting its East-West Pipeline infrastructure.

stories.title: Gulf, Muslim organizations rally behind Saudi Arabia after pipeline attack

en.title: Gulf, Muslim organizations rally behind Saudi Arabia after pipeline attack
en.summary: Multiple Gulf and Muslim organizations condemned drone strikes on Saudi Arabia's East-West oil pipeline on Saturday, expressing support for the Kingdom and warning that such attacks pose a serious threat to regional stability and critical infrastructure.

stories.title: Iraq removes Maysan operations commander after attacks on Saudi Arabia

en.title: Iraq removes Maysan operations commander after attacks on Saudi Arabia
en.summary: Iraq's Prime Minister removed the commander of Maysan Operations Command after determining that attacks on Saudi Arabia originated from the southern Iraqi province, and ordered an investigation into the command.

stories.title: Iraq confirms attacks on Saudi pipeline originated from Iraqi territory

en.title: Iraq confirms attacks on Saudi pipeline originated from Iraqi territory
en.summary: An Iraqi military commander was removed from his position following an investigation that linked drone attacks on Saudi Arabia to Iraqi territory. The investigation was led by the Iraqi prime minister's office.

stories.title: Saudi Arabia says drones from Iraq targeted East-West Pipeline, holds off response

en.title: Saudi Arabia says drones from Iraq targeted East-West Pipeline, holds off response
en.summary: Saudi Arabia reported that multiple drones launched from Iraq struck its East-West Pipeline, causing injuries and damage. The Kingdom chose not to retaliate at this stage following a request from Iraq's prime minister to address the situation.

stories.title: Saudi Arabia shuts East-West oil pipeline after multiple attacks

en.title: Saudi Arabia shuts East-West oil pipeline after multiple attacks
en.summary: Saudi Arabia closed its East-West Pipeline as a precautionary measure following multiple attacks in the Riyadh and Madinah regions on Thursday that caused injuries. Emergency teams secured the pipeline and assessed its safety according to approved procedures.

stories.title: Saudi Arabia urges firm UN Security Council action over Houthi attacks

en.title: Saudi Arabia urges firm UN Security Council action over Houthi attacks
en.summary: Saudi Arabia called on the UN Security Council to take strong action against Houthi attacks on the Kingdom. The country warned that these attacks threaten regional security and international navigation in the Red Sea and Bab Al-Mandab.

stories.title: ‎CEER to launch first EVs in Saudi Arabia on Sept. 21

en.title: CEER to launch first EVs in Saudi Arabia on Sept. 21
en.summary: CEER, Saudi Arabia's first automotive company, will launch its initial electric vehicles including sedan and SUV models on September 21. The launch aligns with Saudi Vision 2030 objectives and aims to strengthen the Kingdom's position in the global automotive sector.

stories.title: ‎Oil prices fall, post weekly gains of over 8%

en.title: Oil prices fall, post weekly gains of over 8%
en.summary: Oil prices declined on Friday as markets reassessed Middle Eastern geopolitical conditions, though crude recorded strong weekly gains exceeding 8% following recent US-Iran military escalation. Supply disruptions from regional tensions and attacks on refineries continue influencing global oil markets.

stories.title: ‎Gold holds steady, posts third straight weekly loss

en.title: Gold holds steady, posts third straight weekly loss
en.summary: Gold prices remained relatively unchanged on Friday but declined for the third consecutive week as investors evaluated US inflation data and monetary policy expectations. Markets are pricing in an increased probability of a Federal Reserve rate hike at its upcoming meeting.

stories.title: ‎Dow rises over 500 points, posts weekly gain

en.title: Dow rises over 500 points, posts weekly gain
en.summary: The Dow Jones Industrial Average increased by over 500 points and recorded gains for the week.
